content: QED jumped to 0.859 and SA improved to 2.07 just from that swap. Step 2 adds the fluorine. Atom 21 is an aromatic CH ortho to atom 13, which bears the arylamine, and meta to atom 10, which bears the anilide - the same substitution pattern as my leader, where that single fluorine appears to be worth real activity. The ring CH hydrogen is implicit, so the new bond displaces it.
